test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If P ÷ Q means that P is the mother of Q, P – Q means that P is the father of Q, P × Q means that P is the sister of Q, then which of the following expression shows that B is the daughter of A?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

P ÷ Q means that A is the mother of B

P - Q means that A is the father of B

P × Q means that A is the sister of B

Given relation code:

 
 

 Code
 Relation
 
 

 ÷ 
 Mother
 
 

 -
 Father
 
 

 × 
 Sister
 
 

Find: Which expression shows that B is the daughter of A?

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) B – A ÷ C

B is the Father of A, and A is the Mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/215c88bed2c9cb80e64173a3e8b874b0c79b3c032c86b9338cac26afbdaa30ae.png] 

Here, B is the father of A. (Incorrect)

Option 2) A – B ÷ C

A is the Father of B and B is the Mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/944f20342526053b1c3d91e8ed25a4d7d262c6dad4838a7e450956b6d0115d5f.png] 

Here, B is the daughter of A. (Correct)

Option 3) A – B - C

A is the Father of B and B is the Father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fec9c1f921e91c5e05dbcf954e70d561085727432105f6c2ce5404913d1eae6d.png] 

Here, B is the son of A. (Incorrect)

Option 4) C ÷ B – A

C is the Mother of B and B is the Father of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23a4a786527f03b45fcea7cef9052df40ac85f9361d1373502f1694f201938ee.png] 

Here, B is the Son of C. (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
